task: Which S&P 500 names should be on our momentum watchlist? Give me the top 20 above their 200-day average, ranked by 12–1 month momentum.
context: Current S&P 500 membership snapshot, with daily prices through 2026-10-16; this is a current-universe screen, not a historical membership backtest.
Use split-adjusted closes for price returns and compatible price/share units for dollar volume. The vendor daily feed does not verify exact regular-session or auction prints.

outputs.name: shortlist
outputs.description: Ranked current-universe shortlist; one row per ticker, ordered by rank.

schema.name: rank
schema.description: Sequential rank starting at 1; descending momentum with ticker ascending as the tie-break.

schema.name: ticker
schema.description: Unique US-listed constituent ticker; the row label is a security, not a timestamp.

schema.name: company
schema.description: Company display name from the resolved asset metadata.

schema.name: sector
schema.description: Sector label from the resolved asset metadata.

schema.name: as_of
schema.description: Exact completed price session used by the screen: 2026-10-16.

schema.name: momentum_12_1
schema.description: Split-adjusted close 21 sessions ago / split-adjusted close 252 sessions ago - 1.

schema.name: return_3m
schema.description: Split-adjusted close at as_of / close 63 sessions ago - 1; price return.

schema.name: distance_to_sma_200
schema.description: As-of split-adjusted close / its trailing 200-session SMA - 1; strictly positive.

schema.name: average_dollar_volume_20
schema.description: Mean of actual quoted close times traded shares over the last 20 sessions, with price/volume on a consistent split basis.

outputs.name: screening_coverage
outputs.description: Exactly one coverage row for the captured roster and price cutoff.

schema.name: as_of
schema.description: Price observation cutoff fixed for this case: 2026-10-16.

schema.name: membership_snapshot_at
schema.description: Actual retrieval timestamp of the current S&P 500 roster; not a claim of historical membership.

schema.name: universe_count
schema.description: Number of unique constituent tickers in the captured roster.

schema.name: excluded_missing_data_count
schema.description: Constituents excluded for missing required history, fields or metadata.

schema.name: eligible_count
schema.description: Constituents with complete required data and a close strictly above their 200-session SMA.

schema.name: returned_count
schema.description: min(20, eligible_count); do not pad the shortlist with failing names.
